name: bluepeak_timeline_draft_for_marcus_bell
use_case: Ask for missing facts instead of inventing them
branch: Grant Walker asks the desk to draft a question to Marcus Bell (L02) about their timeline; Marcus's email is not in the mailbox, so the setup adds thread th_s401_bluepeak with message smsg_401 from marcus.bell@bluepeak.example asking for pricing for 25 seats; read it, get_lead L02, create_draft to Marcus replying to smsg_401
tests: the agent reads Marcus Bell's email thread and drafts a clarification reply asking for their go-live timeline, without sending it
instruction: You are Grant Walker, Account Executive at BrightDesk. Marcus Bell at Bluepeak Software (lead L02) sent an email asking for pricing for 25 seats. Ask the sales desk to draft a question to Marcus asking about their target go-live timeline so you can review it before sending.

persona.name: Grant Walker
persona.initial_message: Marcus Bell from Bluepeak emailed about pricing for 25 seats. Can you draft a question asking for their timeline so I can review it?

arguments.body: Hello Marcus, thanks for reaching out. To provide accurate pricing, what is your expected go-live timeline? Best regards, BrightDesk Sales
arguments.subject: Re: Pricing enquiry for 25 seats
